<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
I believe the source of the problem is that with some of the added overhead of the refactor inside of the roborock package - some users experience timeouts when there are a bunch of requests being sent to the vacuum at the same time, i.e. during startup. Increasing queue timeout by one second should improve the problems. But also I added some error catching from #112047

This should be included in 2024.5 if possible.
